attrib.title: Business savvy: %s's low salary turns into millions
attrib.content:

'I was really pissed off with my agent, to be honest. I thought he had struck a ridiculously bad deal for me but I loved the script so much that I decided to do the movie first and carry out the firing later. In the end though, I had to buy the sneaky bastard a new BMW and postpone his sacking indefinitely, haha.'

The largely overlooked picture, made from less than $20 million, collected a 93 percent average review score on Box Office Butcher as well as over 300 million dollars at the box office. This meant an estimated $15 million bonus for %s, so buying a new car for his agent was more of an insult than a class act of generosity.
